name: iter_paper_lowpretrain
description: PAPER FIGURE SET, setting 2 of 3 (LOW PRETRAINING): the same three mix policies as iter_paper_normal (Constant, Exponential decay x0.1, Adaptive severity; starting mix 0.5) with the initial model weakened to 3 training epochs on 50 points, everything else at the operating point.
